{
  "phoneNote": "The prominent photo pushes the emergency headline halfway down the first screen, while widely separated links make the hero unnecessarily tall.",
  "desktopNote": "The strong typography and relevant imagery suit the trade, but repeated workshop messaging and generous section padding make the page feel stretched.",

    "hierarchy": 4,

    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 3
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Correct the sticky-header positioning so it does not cover the hero headline in the full-page views on either viewport.",
    "On phones, place the emergency headline before the image, shorten the image height, and group the hero action links with tighter spacing.",
    "Merge the workshop feature and closing workshop promotion into one section, and reduce padding around the service-area band and desktop section transitions."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone, hero: the header shown in the full-page capture covers the emergency headline.",
    "Desktop, hero: the header shown in the full-page capture overlaps and obscures the headline."
  ]
}
